No spam - genuine quotes from vetted UK engine specialists only. 8,000+ Engine Codes 40+ Car Brands 100% Free · No Obligation Make Select Make Series Model Select a model Year Select Model First Engine Code Get Free Engine Quotes At a glance · what your white smoke means Match the smoke pattern to the likely cause and urgency White smoke on cold start only, disappears when warm Likely cause: Normal condensation Low £0 (normal) Persistent white smoke, even when warm Likely cause: Coolant entering combustion chamber High £550-£2,000+ White smoke + sweet smell Likely cause: Head gasket failure CRITICAL £550-£2,000+ White smoke + overheating Likely cause: Cracked cylinder head CRITICAL £1,000-£3,000+ Thick white smoke + coolant loss Likely cause: Major internal coolant leak CRITICAL £550-£2,000+ What this usually means in UK cars The crucial distinction: condensation vs. coolant White smoke from your exhaust is one of the most misunderstood symptoms. Here's the truth: Morning condensation = Normal. White vapour that disappears as the engine warms up. Every car does this in UK damp weather. Persistent white smoke = Bad. If smoke continues after the engine reaches operating temperature, coolant is entering the combustion chamber. In our 24,650 quote dataset, 68% of persistent white smoke cases were caused by head gasket failure. The remaining 32% were cracked cylinder heads, intake manifold leaks, or EGR cooler failure (on diesels). The crucial test: Does the smoke have a sweet smell? That's coolant burning. Head gasket failure is almost certain. 1 Condensation Thin white vapour. Disappears when warm. £0 (normal) 2 Head gasket Persistent smoke. Sweet smell. £550-£2,000 3 Cracked head Smoke + overheating. £1,000-£3,000 4 Catastrophic Coolant & oil mix. Engine seizure. £2,500-£10,000+ What people think vs reality The expensive mistake is assuming it's harmless “It's just steam from the cold weather.” Condensation disappears when warm. If it persists, it's coolant burning. “I'll just top up the coolant and keep driving.” You're masking a serious problem. Coolant loss will lead to overheating and engine seizure. “Head gasket failure means I need a new engine.” Not always. Head gasket replacement costs £550-£2,000 - far less than a new engine. “I can use a head gasket sealant to fix it.” These products rarely work and can clog your cooling system. Proper repair is the only reliable solution. Cracked head/block Coolant and oil mix, engine damage £2,500-£10,000+ The Cost Escalation: A £550-£2,000 head gasket repair becomes a £2,500-£10,000+ engine replacement if ignored. What to do next Three steps to protect your engine Step 1: Check Your Coolant Level (£0) Check when engine is cold. Is the coolant level low? Is there oil in the coolant (mayonnaise-like sludge)? Step 2: Check Your Oil (£0) Remove the dipstick or oil filler cap. Is there a creamy/milky substance? (coolant in oil). This confirms head gasket failure. Step 3: Book Professional Diagnostic (£50-£150) A technician will perform a compression test, check for exhaust gases in coolant (chemical test), pressure test the cooling system, and inspect for external leaks. sections.heading: The crucial distinction: condensation vs. coolant

blocks.text: White smoke from your exhaust is one of the most misunderstood symptoms. Here's the truth:
White vapour that disappears as the engine warms up. Every car does this in UK damp weather.
If smoke continues after the engine reaches operating temperature, coolant is entering the combustion chamber.

In our 24,650 quote dataset, 68% of persistent white smoke cases were caused by head gasket failure. The remaining 32% were cracked cylinder heads, intake manifold leaks, or EGR cooler failure (on diesels).
The crucial test: Does the smoke have a sweet smell? That's coolant burning. Head gasket failure is almost certain.

blocks.question: How do I know if white smoke is condensation or head gasket? +
blocks.answer: Condensation disappears when the engine is warm. Head gasket smoke persists and has a sweet smell.

blocks.question: Can I drive with white smoke? +
blocks.answer: If it's condensation only - yes. If it's persistent, sweet-smelling, or comes with a warning light - no.

blocks.question: How much does head gasket repair cost in the UK? +
blocks.answer: Head gasket repair costs £550-£2,000+ depending on engine type, vehicle access, and whether the head needs skimming.

blocks.question: Is white smoke from a diesel different from petrol? +
blocks.answer: Diesel produces more condensation and can produce white smoke on cold start that looks like a problem - but if it persists, same rule applies.
